environment.browser: Recorded per run; each variant ran in a fresh headless Chromium process
environment.processIsolation: Fresh Chromium process and BrowserContext for every baseline/candidate variant; renderer process cap 2
environment.harness: Vite dev server, ReactDOM client render, installed Mantine 9.6.0 Collapse, React 19 Activity, TanStack Query 5.101.2
environment.browserData: Synthetic BoardCard props; no Homarr server, database, images, thumbnails, or remote integrations
environment.targetComponents: BoardCard from frozen baseline snapshot; live DuplicateBoardForm and live useBoardNameStatus/BoardNameAvailability
environment.candidateDelta: Instrumentation-only transform adds keepMounted={false} to the baseline Collapse prop
environment.transport: Synthetic HTTP POST intercepted by Playwright with raw JSON bodies; gzip sizes are calculated estimates and are not browser-measured compressed transfer bytes
environment.runs: 1, 25, 100 boards x 1 alternating baseline/candidate pairs x board-create/no-board-create; five open/close/navigation cycles; each run uses a fresh Chromium process and BrowserContext
